name: video-trimmer-in-between
title: 剪切和重新加入视频部分
description: Get trimmed joined clips ready to post, without touching a single slider. Upload your video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB), say something like "remove the section between 0:45 and 1:20 and join the remaining parts smoothly", and download 1080p MP4 when it's done. Built for content creators who move fast and want to remove a specific middle portion of a video without affecting the beginning or end.
title_en: Video Trimmer In Between — Cut and Rejoin Video Sections
